BANCROFT INDEPENDENT PARENTS' COMMITTEE 


On Tuesday, April 22, Protestant teachers in Mcntreal held a 1-day 
strike against the Québec government and the School Boards. The teachers 
are demanding fewer children per class, a voice in cecisions at school, 
job security, and other ‘questions directly related to a better education 
for our children. ; 

In more than 100 echools throughout Montreal, perents demonstrated 
their support for -the teachers' just demands - which are parents'cemands 
av well, Bancroft parents joined striking teachers on the picket line 
to show their support and meet the teachers; the same thing happened 
at many Montreal. schools. At several schools, parents circulated peti- 
tions supporting the teachers. ; 

Before the strike, the Québec Association of Protestant School 
Boards sent al] principals a confidential directive on how to breek the 
teachers! strike. This document came into the hands of the teachers! 
Union, as well as our Committee's. It orders principals to use parents 
and high school students to break the strike, just like bosses use strike- 
preakers at the factory against the workers. I+t also orders principals ~ 
to make sure scab teachers get financial support. ar: 

But the secret got out, so the authorities had to~change tactics 
and elose the school to all pupils. The fact that Hall 1s holding a 
meeting of his bogus, "committee" this week has plenty to do with this 
new anti-teacher plan. Hall will try to turn us away from the correct
